convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <scratch.pen>; execute({ input: 'Export(["<frameId>", ...], "png", "<dir>")' }) — default scale 2; the .pen MUST sit at its committed lane path so the relative library import resolves. Re-export verified byte-deterministic across consecutive runs on the final file; default and static-print exports are byte-identical (the contract's identical-by-construction claim).
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch threshold 0.1 (harness convention), per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; states.json pixelThreshold 0.03 is the Gate-1 story-vs-pen budget, not this loop's). Targets = NORMALIZED prototype, contract root #tsHost section.ts, Chromium via playwright 1.58.2 (headless shell 145.0.7632.6), deviceScaleFactor 2, viewport 1280x900 (420x800 for narrow-squish / narrow-scroll-carets per states.json). Capture protocol (v001 protocol carried): Google Fonts origins blocked + @font-face injection serving Heebo AND Noto Serif from the SAME TTFs the .pen references (pencil/designs/fonts/); --font-render-hinting=none --disable-font-subpixel-positioning; animations/transitions frozen; scrollbars hidden (chrome, not content); root nudged onto the integer CSS-pixel grid (paint-only); fonts ready; states driven by the states.json prototype steps verbatim; self-consistency gate (double screenshot, byte-equal). Geometry probes: per-state scene-derived pixel probes (dot centers, swatch centers, gridline/baseline rows, card interior) asserted target-vs-export agreement at the same coordinates — all pass.
convergence.iterationNotes: Up-front measurement (not iterations): per-size pen-vs-Chromium text baseline calibration probe (17 Heebo sizes + Noto Serif 18) drove the ascent model, so It1 authored from extracted geometry landed 15/15 within the 1.0% budget (worst 0.573%) with all text ink boxes within +/-0.5 css px of the target. It1 defect found by node inspection (the numeric budget had absorbed it): the caret chevron path carried no stroke (SVG currentColor inheritance missed by the extractor); fixed the extraction, regenerated, re-exported. It2: 15/15 within budget, worst 0.559% (narrow-squish), all geometry probes pass. Residual is glyph-edge antialiasing between the pen renderer and Chromium (measured ink-box offsets <= 0.5 css px everywhere) — the irreducible cross-rasterizer class the SC standard anticipates. No waivers.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: RAMP palette (the v4.13 default dataset): seven hues at 100%/60% alpha, in hue order
